verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs show a machine-readable Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export and Excel report exports. Its AI Tie Out Assistant and Health Checks flag mismatches between legal documents and the cap table, which covers part of the reconciliation need inside the product. However, there is no evidence of an API or agent-accessible endpoint for pulling the cap table programmatically, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented cap-table API or agent/MCP access, programmatic (non-manual) export, reconciliation against an external data room rather than documents uploaded into AngelList, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
